mapper.sql: i.id, i.sku_id, i.warehouse_id, i.user_id, i.stock, i.locked_stock, i.in_transit_stock, i.safety_stock, i.max_stock, i.stock_warn_enable, i.cost_price, i.version, i.create_by, i.update_by, i.create_time, i.update_time, (i.stock - i.locked_stock) AS availableStock

FROM shop_erp_inventory i LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product pr ON pr.id = sk.product_id AND pr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = i.user_id
mapper.select:

AND (pr.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR pr.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR w.warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR sk.spec_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND sk.product_id = #{q.productId}
AND i.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}

WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_erp_inventory SET stock = stock + #{delta}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, user_id = #{userId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0 AND stock + #{delta} >= 0

UPDATE shop_erp_inventory SET stock = stock - #{delta}, locked_stock = locked_stock - #{release}, user_id = #{userId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0 AND stock - #{delta} >= 0 AND locked_stock - #{release} >= 0 AND stock - locked_stock - #{delta} + #{release} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT i.warehouse_id FROM shop_erp_inventory i JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.sku_id = #{skuId} AND (i.stock - i.locked_stock) >= #{quantity} ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(w.longitude, w.latitude), POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) ASC, i.warehouse_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.warehouse_id FROM shop_erp_inventory i JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.sku_id = #{skuId} AND (i.stock - i.locked_stock) >= #{quantity} AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{district}, w.area_code) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(#{city}, w.area_code) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(#{province}, w.area_code) > 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN FIND_IN_SET(#{district}, w.area_code) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN FIND_IN_SET(#{city}, w.area_code) > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, i.warehouse_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT w.id FROM shop_erp_warehouse w JOIN shop_erp_inventory i ON i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.sku_id = #{skuId} WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.store_id = #{storeId} AND (i.stock - i.locked_stock) >= #{quantity} ORDER BY i.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.stock - i.locked_stock), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_erp_warehouse w WHERE w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1) AND i.sku_id = #{skuId}
AND i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
